query: Lagos bus routes GTFS feed LAMATA
Lagos danfo route map open data
Berger bus stop Lagos route to Lagos Island

text: Checking what the search results actually contain

verdict.name: Rin (Lagos)
verdict.oneLine: Tell a Lagos commuter which bus gets them from A to B.
verdict.reason: Failed: Real queries are covered (Coverage test)
verdict.headline: The only published Lagos transit data covers 8 corridors, and the first stop a real commuter typed was not in it.

checks.title: One job
checks.finding: One sentence, one job: find the bus route between two stops.

checks.title: Not already solved
checks.finding: Nothing the commuter already has routes Lagos danfo and BRT trips. Mapping apps have almost no Lagos bus routes to draw on.

evidence.title: OpenStreetMap
evidence.fact: The studio's check found 2 bus route relations for the whole Lagos metro, against 140+ in Nairobi.

checks.title: Data already exists
checks.finding: A published feed exists: the LAMATA GTFS feed, 171 stops on 8 corridors, last dated 2024.

evidence.title: OpenStreetMap
evidence.fact: The only other open source, with 2 Lagos bus routes mapped.

checks.title: Near-zero cost per user
checks.finding: A static feed read on the device or from one small server. No per-user messages, no per-query AI.

checks.title: Real queries are covered
checks.finding: "Berger", the first stop typed, is not in the feed. The feed is 8 mainland feeder corridors, not Lagos.

queries.note: Not in the feed at all.
Island stops are outside the 8 corridors.

verdict.killer: Data ceiling. No public dataset covers Lagos informal transit, and collecting it means surveys or a partnership: money and time.
verdict.nextTest: Before any city is picked, type ten stops a real commuter uses into that city's feed and count the misses.
unknowns: Whether LAMATA plans to publish the remaining corridors.
verdict.killLogLine: | Rin (Lagos) | Data ceiling: LAMATA feed = 8 corridors; OSM = 2 routes in all of Lagos. Passed the Law, failed coverage |
verdict.idea: Rin: tell a Lagos commuter which bus route gets them from where they are to where they are going, using published transit data.
